title: Essay hero: a two-line serif title left with a sans deck, two pill buttons and a meta line, a large seeded pixel burst of clay rounded squares right
use: The opening of a research essay, report or long-form explainer; the burst is the picture, so no art is needed. seed and density change the burst.

density.note: share of the burst kept (higher is denser)

brand.default: 示例研究所 · 研究笔记

title_1.note: title line 1; the width decides: about 9 CJK or 14 Latin characters

deck.default: 三种情景下的算力需求、供应链利润分配与估值含义。

relations: H1 76 units / 1.13 serif weight 400 in two lines left; deck 20 sans #5E5D59 under it; two pills 48 high with a 1 unit hairline and a 12 unit gap; meta 15 sans.
The burst is a 15 x 15 grid in a 640-unit square, radius 7.5 cells, right of the title (centre x 1180); clay is the only colour and stays under 22% of the canvas for every seed.
decoration: The burst's watercolour filter and the squares' opacity (0.78-1) are decoration.

provenance.corpus: research-report kit (examples/institute-essay-report-kit): our own original long-read page in the institute-essay grammar; all copy and numbers are placeholders
provenance.experiment: styles/institute-essay/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped)
provenance.method: The reference pages' hero (serif title left, pixel burst right, two pill buttons) re-set on a 1600 x 900 canvas; sizes scaled from the measured 78 / 17 px.
measured: H1 78 px / 1.1 serif 400, deck 17 px sans #5E5D59, pill radius 99 with a 1 px hairline, burst of clay rounded squares to the right of the title.
Template: the burst passes the 22% accent budget for 50 seeds and density 0.3-0.8.
